scenarios.name: Student Scholarship

requirements.label: Identity
requirements.description: Prove the applicant's identity with an official identity document (Aadhaar / Passport / ID).
requirements.helpText: Why am I being asked for this document? ClearGov must confirm that the claim is made by a real, identifiable citizen before any benefit is considered.

requirements.label: Academic Eligibility
requirements.description: Previous examination marksheet confirming the applicant meets the academic threshold.
requirements.helpText: Why am I being asked for this document? This scholarship covers students above a defined academic threshold.

requirements.label: Family Income
requirements.description: Income certificate establishing annual family income within the ceiling.
requirements.helpText: Why am I being asked for this document? Eligibility is means-tested — the benefit is reserved for families below the annual income ceiling.

requirements.label: Residence
requirements.description: Residence proof confirming the applicant lives within the service area.
requirements.helpText: Why am I being asked for this document? The scholarship is administered by the district the applicant resides in.

requirements.label: Bank Proof
requirements.description: Passbook or account statement with the applicant's account and branch details for disbursement.
requirements.helpText: Why am I being asked for this document? The scholarship amount is disbursed only to a verified bank account in the applicant's name.
